story: At the Nottingham Inn Kitchen & Creamery you find a warm, inviting atmosphere with great food, exceptional service and a setting that truly lets you relax. Always family-friendly, the Kitchen & Creamery is casual, full-service dining at its best. We feature delicious, satisfying American heartland cuisine at moderate prices with fresh products and produce from local farms and dairies. And don’t forget to finish your meal with one of our old-fashioned ice cream treats! Nottingham Creamery gets a private concept homepage, not a mailed pitch.
